title: IMERG Daily Precipitation Climatology (2001–2022)

source.provider: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio (Earth Information Center)

roi.note: Native-resolution crop of the 2048x1024 frame (no resampling).

colorbar.note: SVS colorbar is mm/day; IMERG measurements in this app are mm/hr (×24 for mm/day).

derivatives: One representative frame per day (middle of each overlay run), WebP: full 1024×512 and ROI crop.
